nodes.description: AlphaPass.name public string state variable holding the collection name 'Alpha Pass'.
AlphaPass.symbol public string state variable holding the collection symbol 'AP'.
AlphaPass.maxSupply total mintable cap, mutable by owner via setMaxSupply.
AlphaPass.price per-token price in wei, mutable by owner via setCurrentPrice.
AlphaPass.baseURI prefix used to build token URIs, mutable by owner.
AlphaPass.mintedTokens mapping(uint256=>bool) tracking token ids already minted by whales.
AlphaPass.totalMinted counter of all Alpha Passes minted so far.
AlphaPass.WhaleContract external ERC721Enumerable reference used for holder eligibility and enumeration.
ERC1155._balances mapping(uint256=>mapping(address=>uint256)) internal ledger of Alpha Pass balances.
Ownable._owner privileged address gate for onlyOwner functions.
msg.sender caller of mint/constructor, controls whale lookup and minting loop parameters.
AlphaPass.mint(uint256 amount) external payable: takes ETH, verifies whale NFT ownership and mints one Alpha Pass per owned whale token id.
AlphaPass.uri(uint256 tokenId) public view override: requires mintedTokens[tokenId] and concatenates baseURI with the decimal token id.
AlphaPass.totalSupply() public view: forwards to WhaleContract.totalSupply().
AlphaPass.setBaseUri(string) external onlyOwner: updates the URI prefix.
AlphaPass.setCurrentPrice(uint256) external onlyOwner: updates the mint price.
AlphaPass.setMaxSupply(uint256) external onlyOwner: updates the total supply cap.
AlphaPass constructor: initializes ERC1155 uri and Ownable owner from the deployer.
ERC1155._mint(address to,uint256 id,uint256 amount,bytes data): writes _balances and emits TransferSingle.
ERC1155._doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck: calls IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155Received when the recipient is a contract.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: requires owner() == _msgSender() before executing the guarded function body.
External calls WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender) and WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender,i) to a hardcoded external contract inside the mint flow.
External callback onERC1155Received executed by the recipient contract during _mint, before mintedTokens/totalMinted are updated in mint().
Parameter amount of AlphaPass.mint, number of Alpha Passes requested and used in price*amount and totalMinted+amount.
Parameter tokenId of AlphaPass.uri, used for the mintedTokens existence require and URI construction.
Parameter newUri of setBaseUri, written into baseURI.
Parameter newPrice of setCurrentPrice, written into price.
Parameter newSupply of setMaxSupply, written into maxSupply.
Local variable wBalance in mint: result of WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender), bounds the mint loop.
Local variable minted in mint: counter of Alpha Passes minted in the current call, breaks the loop at amount.
Local variable wTokenId in mint: whale token id fetched via tokenOfOwnerByIndex, used as Alpha Pass id.
Local loop index i in mint iterating over the caller's whale token ids.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted caller of mint and determines whale eligibility lookup and mint recipient.
mint reads price to compute the required payment check price * amount <= msg.value.
mint reads maxSupply to enforce totalMinted + amount <= maxSupply.
mint reads totalMinted for the maximum supply check.
totalMinted is incremented after the external _mint acceptance callback, so reentrancy can desynchronize the supply counter.
mint reads mintedTokens[wTokenId] to skip whale token ids that already produced an Alpha Pass.
mintedTokens[wTokenId] is set to true after the _mint callback, allowing the same token id to be minted again during reentrancy.
mint depends on the external WhaleContract reference for balance and token id enumeration.
Results of WhaleContract.balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex flow back into mint as wBalance and wTokenId.
mint invokes the external WhaleContract view calls before checking mintedTokens and before updating state.
mint calls the inherited ERC1155 _mint to issue the Alpha Pass to msg.sender.
_mint ends with _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck, transferring control to the recipient if it is a contract.
_doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck performs an external callback onERC1155Received on the recipient contract.
The recipient callback can re-enter mint before mintedTokens and totalMinted are updated (checks-effects-interactions violated).
_mint increases the recipient entry of the ERC1155 _balances ledger.
User-controlled amount is multiplied by price and added to totalMinted (checked arithmetic in 0.8, reverts on overflow).
wBalance is the untrusted external return value that bounds the mint loop iteration count.
mint stores the result of WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender) into wBalance.
wTokenId is used as the lookup key in mintedTokens and as the Alpha Pass id passed to _mint.
mint stores WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender, i) into wTokenId.
The minted counter controls the early loop break when minted >= amount.
mint increments the minted counter for every newly issued Alpha Pass.
Loop index i drives the mint iteration over the caller's whale token ids.
uri reads baseURI when building the token metadata URI.
uri requires mintedTokens[tokenId] to be true before returning metadata.
Unvalidated tokenId parameter is used for the existence check and URI string building.
totalSupply returns the value read from the external WhaleContract.totalSupply().
onlyOwner reads _owner to compare against the current caller.
onlyOwner restricts setBaseUri to the contract owner.
onlyOwner restricts setCurrentPrice to the contract owner.
onlyOwner restricts setMaxSupply to the contract owner.
newUri parameter is written into baseURI by setBaseUri.
setBaseUri assigns newUri to the baseURI state variable.
newPrice parameter is written into price by setCurrentPrice.
setCurrentPrice assigns newPrice to the price state variable used by mint.
newSupply parameter is written into maxSupply by setMaxSupply.
setMaxSupply assigns newSupply to the maxSupply state variable used by mint.
Ownable constructor sets the initial privileged owner address.
The deployer (msg.sender) becomes the initial owner through _msgSender() in the constructor.
msg.sender is passed as the account argument to WhaleContract.balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists inside mint and should be collapsed into the mint function node it parameterizes.
The tokenId parameter is only used inside uri and should be merged into the uri function node.
The newUri parameter is only used by setBaseUri and should be merged into that function node.
The newPrice parameter is only used by setCurrentPrice and should be merged into that function node.
The newSupply parameter is only used by setMaxSupply and should be merged into that function node.
wBalance is a mint-local temporary holding an external call result and should be folded into the mint function node.
minted is a mint-local loop counter and should be folded into the mint function node.
wTokenId is a mint-local temporary used as the Alpha Pass id and should be folded into the mint function node.
i is the mint loop index and should be folded into the mint function node.
